sections.Profile:
Crystal-Ball, released by Talleres del Llobregat in 1970, is a one-player electro-mechanical game built in Barcelona.

- Manufacturer: Talleres del Llobregat S.A.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Mystical, Single Player, Fortune Telling, Original Theme, 1970s
